question: For what purpose does one take another form in relation to the wicked?
premises: The wicked are opposed to Kula.
Divine power can assume other forms.
Such assumption can serve to delude the wicked.
inference: Another form is taken in order to delude the wicked.
uncertainties: The subject taking another form is implicit from context.
plain_english: Indeed, taking another form, it is for the delusion of the wicked.
